She took the time to learn our dog’s routine, preferences, and little quirks, and kept us updated with photos and messages throughout the stay, which gave us total peace of mind.

Our dog came home relaxed, happy, and clearly very well cared for. It’s obvious she treats every pet like family.

I’d highly recommend Marilia to anyone looking for a trustworthy, responsible, and genuinely kind sitter. We’ll definitely be booking again! 🐾💛
